## What shipped
- **`server.js`** — `POST /password`: `405` non-POST → `401` unauthed → `400` bad/blank/non-string body / malformed JSON → `200` on success. Re-hashes `newPassword` with the existing `hashPassword` scrypt scheme, then revokes every session for the user (including the token that authorized the request).
- **`src/store.js`** — two durably-flushed methods: `setUserPassword` (rotate salt+hash) and `deleteSessionsForUser` (revoke all sessions), so revocation survives a restart.
- **`test/api.test.js`** — 3 contract tests: credential rotation + old/new login, prior-session revocation on `GET /me`, bad-request paths, and on-disk rotation with no plaintext.
